rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's twenty builder trees go (canary date palms, corals and ficus along the back fences, fan and queen palms 1.2-4.2 m from the houses, others in the yards); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the three grills, on the open lot corner, and one on the old back fence row.

trees.why: the back yard with the kettle grill (2.7 m off): a magnolia over the cook
the west yard's kettle grill (1.6 m off), 37 m on: a jacaranda over it
the south yard's kettle grill (2.4 m off): a coral tree over it
the open lot corner at the north-east, 20 m from the walls: a full coral tree
the south-west back yard, 5.5 m from the house: the one tree of the old back fence row there
